ordinary.en: To many ordinary people, the old elite had lived above the law for decades.
ordinary.zh: 对许多普通人来说，老一代精英几十年来一直凌驾于法律之上。

ordinary.en: This one ran safely for decades, and only closed in 2019, for ordinary financial reasons.
ordinary.zh: 这一个反应堆安全运行了数十年，直到2019年才因普通的财务原因关闭。

ordinary.en: For many people in Woldham, Jason included, debt was an ordinary feature of daily life.
ordinary.zh: 对于沃尔德姆的许多人来说，包括杰森在内，负债是日常生活的一个普通特征。

ordinary.en: It's a perfectly reasonable question to ask: why use ordinary people at all?
ordinary.zh: 这是个完全合理的问题：为什么一开始就要让普通人参与其中？

ordinary.en: But the vast majority of people living in favelas are ordinary people working and raising families.
ordinary.zh: 但绝大多数住在贫民窟里的人都是普通人，他们辛苦工作、养家糊口。

origin.en: It is also, in its origins, not really British at all; it's Italian.
origin.zh: 然而从它的起源来看，它其实一点也不英国，它是意大利的。

origin.en: Their origins stretch back over 5,000 years, making them among the oldest civilizations in the world.
origin.zh: 他们的起源可以追溯到5000多年前，使他们成为世界上最古老的文明之一。

origin.en: They may have developed from a very specific historical or cultural origin.
origin.zh: 它们可能是从非常特殊的历史或文化渊源中发展而来的。

origin.en: Ah yes. I asked you about the origin of the term play date.
origin.zh: 哦，是的。我问过你“play date”这个词的起源。

origin.en: Is the origin in: a) Australia? b) New Zealand? or, c) the United States of America?
origin.zh: 它的起源是：a) 澳大利亚？b) 新西兰？还是 c) 美利坚合众国？

organic.en: Scott says protein has a health halo, a marketing term which describes perceiving a food to be healthy based on a single feature, such as being 'organic', 'gluten-free' or in this case 'high-protein', even if its overall nutritional value is poor.
organic.zh: Scott说蛋白质具有“健康光环”，这是一个营销术语，用来形容人们仅仅根据某一个特征（如“有机”、“无gluten”或在本例中的“高蛋白”）就认为某种食物是健康的，即便其整体营养价值其实很差。

original.en: None of the original wood remained. And this created a puzzle or a paradox.
original.zh: 原来的木头一点也没有剩下。这就产生了一个谜题或悖论。

original.en: One reason for not updating tech is if the original design still works well.
original.zh: 不更新科技的一个原因，是最初的设计依然运行良好。

original.en: The original Roman calendar had only 10 months, starting in March and ending in December.
original.zh: 最初的罗马历只有 10 个月，从 3 月开始，到 12 月结束。

original.en: Questions that connect the current topic to the original goal and keep the conversation moving.
original.zh: 那些能将当前话题与最初目标联系起来并让对话继续推进的问题。

original.en: If none of the original parts are left, can we still call it his ship?
original.zh: 如果原来的零件一个都不剩了，我们还能叫它他的船吗？

organ.en: Our blood needs water so it can carry nutrients to the body's cells and organs.
organ.zh: 我们的血液需要水来将营养物质输送到身体的细胞和器官。

organ.en: It collects the sounds and it funnels them in towards the sense organ.
organ.zh: 它收集声音并将其汇聚到感觉器官中。

organ.en: It's a special sense, and the ear is really the hearing organ.
organ.zh: 这是一种特殊的感官，而耳朵实际上就是听觉器官。

organ.en: When we breathe in, receptor cells in the nose detect molecules in the air and send them to olfactory organs in the brain.
organ.zh: 当我们吸气时，鼻子里的受体细胞探测到空气中的分子，并将它们发送到大脑的嗅觉器官。

organ.en: To understand anatomy better, he carefully cut open human and animal bodies to study their bones and their muscles and their organs.
organ.zh: 为了更好地理解解剖学，他仔细剖开人和动物的身体来研究它们的骨骼、肌肉和器官。

orchard.en: I grew up as a small child in an apple orchard and so we could pick them fresh off the tree.
orchard.zh: 我在一个苹果园里长大，所以我们可以直接从树上摘下来吃。

orphan.en: They were children, many of them orphans.
orphan.zh: 他们是儿童，其中许多是孤儿。

orphan.en: Today, a pregnant single mother, an orphaned child or a man too old to work is no longer forced to ring the bell outside the workhouse gates; there are systems and safeguards in place to ensure that everyone, in theory, has the right to a dignified existence.
orphan.zh: 今天，一个怀孕的单亲妈妈、一个孤儿或一个年纪太大而无法工作的男子，再也不用被迫按响济贫院大门外的铃铛；现在有了各种系统和保障措施，以确保每个人在理论上都享有过上有尊严生活的权利。

orbit.en: And then there’s the most ambitious idea of all: changing the speed of the Earth’s orbit around the sun.
orbit.zh: 还有最宏伟的想法：改变地球绕太阳公转的速度。

orbit.en: One example is the Earth’s orbit around the sun.
orbit.zh: 其中一个例子就是地球绕太阳的公转。

orbit.en: So, let’s start with some definitions. Asteroids are objects that orbit the sun, much like planets, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, and so on.
orbit.zh: 所以，让我们从一些定义开始。小行星是围绕太阳运行的天体，这一点很像行星，比如地球、火星、木星等等。

orbit.en: So, we know where asteroids are, and because they orbit the sun, it is fairly easy to model their position at any point in time.
orbit.zh: 所以，我们知道小行星在哪里，而且因为它们绕太阳运行，模拟它们在任何时间点的位置其实相当容易。

orientation.en: Another important way in which cultures differ is something called “time orientation”.
orientation.zh: 时间取向指的是一种文化更喜欢关注时间的哪一部分：过去、现在还是未来。

orientation.en: Time orientation refers to which part of time a culture likes to focus on: the past, the present, or the future.
orientation.zh: 在面向过去的文化中，人们高度珍视他们的传统。

orientation.en: The “guards” were asked to report to Stanford University on the first day of the experiment to begin their training and orientation.
orientation.zh: “狱警”们被要求在实验第一天到斯坦福大学报到，开始接受培训和岗前指导。

organization.en: It also required government organization capable of planning and feeding and managing labor forces.
organization.zh: 它还需要能够规划、供给和管理劳动力的政府组织能力。

organization.en: UNESCO is the United Nations organization responsible for protecting important historical and cultural sites.
organization.zh: UNESCO是负责保护重要历史和文化遗址的联合国机构。

organization.en: And we should also talk about FIFA, the international organization that governs football.
organization.zh: 我们还应该谈谈国际足联（FIFA），这个管理足球运动的国际组织。

organization.en: Prussia developed a reputation for strict organization and strong leadership and a military culture.
organization.zh: 普鲁士以严明的组织、强大的领导力和军事文化而闻名。

organization.en: Another factor is weak institutions. Institutions are organizations and systems in a country.
organization.zh: 另一个因素是体制薄弱。体制是一个国家中的组织和系统。

originate.en: Potatoes originated in South America. But nobody seriously argues that fish and chips isn’t British.
originate.zh: 土豆起源于南美洲。但没有人会认真争论炸鱼薯条不是英国菜。

originate.en: This name reflected their low status and harsh working conditions, and I think originated from Singapore.
originate.zh: 这个名字反映了他们低下的社会地位和恶劣的工作条件，我想它起源于新加坡。

originate.en: Take the United States. Pizza is very strongly associated with New York food culture, even though pizza is an Italian food, originated in Italy.
originate.zh: 以美国为例。披萨与纽约的饮食文化有着极强的联系，尽管披萨是一种源自意大利的意大利食物。

originate.en: It originated in Mesopotamia thousands of years ago and follows King Gilgamesh on a journey searching for immortality after the death of his friend.
originate.zh: 它几千年前起源于美索不达米亚，讲述了吉尔伽美什国王在朋友死后踏上寻求永生之旅的故事。

organize.en: The result is that Singapore often appears as a clean, organized, and efficient city.
organize.zh: 结果就是，新加坡经常呈现出一个干净、有组织和高效的城市形象。

organize.en: This uprising was organized mainly by the Polish resistance movement, known as the Home Army.
organize.zh: 这场起义主要是由被称为“家乡军”的波兰抵抗运动组织起来的。

organize.en: Instead, he focused more on organizing his notes and on his past work.
organize.zh: 相反，他把更多精力放在整理笔记和回顾过去的工作上。

organize.en: They were watching over the people. Rapa Nui society was organized around families and clans.
organize.zh: 它们在守护着人民。Rapa Nui 的社会是以家庭和氏族为组织结构的。

organize.en: After arriving and spreading across the continent, Aboriginal Australians developed societies that were small but organized.
organize.zh: 在抵达并遍布这片大陆后，澳大利亚原住民发展出了规模虽小但组织有序的社会。

oral.en: This is known as an oral tradition. There are still some cultures around the world that maintain the oral tradition.
oral.zh: 这被称为口头传统。世界上仍有一些文化保持着口头传统。

oral.en: This is known as an oral tradition. There are still some cultures around the world that maintain the oral tradition.
oral.zh: 这被称为口头传统。世界上仍有一些文化保持着口头传统。

orthodox.en: At the same time, Constantinople was the heart of Orthodox Christianity.
orthodox.zh: 与此同时，君士坦丁堡是正教会基督教的心脏。
